```{r}
# Section 2
# Set up Python and IBM CPLEX
python_bin <- Sys.which("python3")
if (python_bin == "") {
  stop("python3 was not found. Install Python 3 before continuing.")
}
run_python_command <- function(args) {
  out <- suppressWarnings(
    system2(
      python_bin,
      args = args,
      stdout = TRUE,
      stderr = TRUE
    )
  )
  status <- attr(out, "status")
  if (is.null(status)) {
    status <- 0L
  }
  list(
    output = out,
    status = status
  )
}
check_cplex <- run_python_command(
  c(
    "-c",
    shQuote("import cplex; print(cplex.__version__)")
  )
)
if (check_cplex$status != 0) {
  cat(
    "Python CPLEX package not found. Attempting installation...\n"
  )
  system2(
    python_bin,
    args = c(
      "-m",
      "pip",
      "install",
      "cplex",
      "docplex"
    )
  )
  check_cplex <- run_python_command(
    c(
      "-c",
      shQuote(
        "import cplex; print(cplex.__version__)"
      )
    )
  )
}
if (check_cplex$status != 0) {
  cat(
    paste(
      check_cplex$output,
      collapse = "\n"
    ),
    "\n"
  )
  stop(
    "CPLEX could not be imported into Python."
  )
}
cat(
  "Using Python:",
  python_bin,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "CPLEX version:",
  paste(
    check_cplex$output,
    collapse = " "
  ),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Section 3
# Create Python CPLEX solver
CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT <- file.path(
  tempdir(),
  "solve_cplex_experiment3.py"
)
python_solver <- c(
  "import sys",
  "import cplex",
  "",
  "lpfile = sys.argv[1]",
  "solfile = sys.argv[2]",
  "time_limit = float(sys.argv[3])",
  "",
  "problem = cplex.Cplex(lpfile)",
  "",
  "problem.set_log_stream(None)",
  "problem.set_warning_stream(None)",
  "problem.set_results_stream(None)",
  "problem.set_error_stream(None)",
  "",
  "problem.parameters.threads.set(1)",
  "problem.parameters.clocktype.set(2)",
  "problem.parameters.timelimit.set(time_limit)",
  "problem.parameters.mip.tolerances.mipgap.set(1e-6)",
  "problem.parameters.emphasis.numerical.set(1)",
  "",
  "try:",
  "    problem.solve()",
  "except Exception as exc:",
  "    print('CPLEX exception:', str(exc))",
  "    try:",
  "        print('CPLEX status code:', problem.solution.get_status())",
  "        print('CPLEX status:', problem.solution.get_status_string())",
  "    except Exception:",
  "        pass",
  "    sys.exit(1)",
  "",
  "status_code = problem.solution.get_status()",
  "status = problem.solution.get_status_string()",
  "",
  "print('CPLEX status code:', status_code)",
  "print('CPLEX status:', status)",
  "",
  "has_solution = problem.solution.is_primal_feasible()",
  "print('Has primal feasible:', int(has_solution))",
  "",
  "if not has_solution:",
  "    print('No primal feasible solution found.')",
  "    sys.exit(2)",
  "",
  "objective = problem.solution.get_objective_value()",
  "print('Objective:', objective)",
  "",
  "try:",
  "    gap = problem.solution.MIP.get_mip_relative_gap()",
  "    print('MIP gap:', gap)",
  "except Exception:",
  "    pass",
  "",
  "problem.solution.write(solfile)"
)
writeLines(
  python_solver,
  CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT
)
cat(
  "Created CPLEX solver at:\n",
  CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT,
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Section 4
# Exact fixed-size best subset selection using CPLEX
best_subset_cplex <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s,
    M = 20,
    time_limit = 300
) {
  n <- nrow(X)
  p <- ncol(X)
  work <- tempfile(
    "cplex_"
  )
  dir.create(
    work
  )
  on.exit(
    unlink(
      work,
      recursive = TRUE
    ),
    add = TRUE
  )
  lpfile <- file.path(
    work,
    "model.lp"
  )
  solfile <- file.path(
    work,
    "solution.sol"
  )
  con <- file(
    lpfile,
    "wt"
  )
  writeLines(
    "Minimize",
    con
  )
  writeLines(
    " obj: [",
    con
  )
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " + 2 r_%d ^ 2",
        i
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  writeLines(
    " ] / 2",
    con
  )
  writeLines(
    "Subject To",
    con
  )
  chunk <- 10
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    starts <- seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = chunk
    )
    for (cc in seq_along(starts)) {
      start <- starts[cc]
      finish <- min(
        start + chunk - 1,
        p
      )
      txt <- ""
      if (cc == 1) {
        txt <- sprintf(
          " resid_%d:",
          i
        )
      }
      for (j in start:finish) {
        a <- X[
          i,
          j
        ]
        if (abs(a) < 1e-14) {
          next
        }
        if (a >= 0) {
          txt <- paste0(
            txt,
            sprintf(
              " + %.12g beta_%d",
              a,
              j
            )
          )
        } else {
          txt <- paste0(
            txt,
            sprintf(
              " - %.12g beta_%d",
              -a,
              j
            )
          )
        }
      }
      if (finish == p) {
        txt <- paste0(
          txt,
          sprintf(
            " + r_%d = %.12g",
            i,
            y[i]
          )
        )
      }
      writeLines(
        txt,
        con
      )
    }
  }
  for (j in seq_len(p)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " U%d: beta_%d - %.12g z_%d <= 0",
        j,
        j,
        M,
        j
      ),
      con
    )
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " L%d: - beta_%d - %.12g z_%d <= 0",
        j,
        j,
        M,
        j
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  writeLines(
    " card:",
    con
  )
  for (
    start in seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = 25
    )
  ) {
    finish <- min(
      start + 24,
      p
    )
    txt <- ""
    for (j in start:finish) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " + z_%d",
          j
        )
      )
    }
    if (finish == p) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " = %d",
          s
        )
      )
    }
    writeLines(
      txt,
      con
    )
  }
  writeLines(
    "Bounds",
    con
  )
  for (j in seq_len(p)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " -%.12g <= beta_%d <= %.12g",
        M,
        j,
        M
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  for (i in seq_len(n)) {
    writeLines(
      sprintf(
        " r_%d free",
        i
      ),
      con
    )
  }
  writeLines(
    "Binary",
    con
  )
  for (
    start in seq(
      1,
      p,
      by = 25
    )
  ) {
    finish <- min(
      start + 24,
      p
    )
    txt <- ""
    for (j in start:finish) {
      txt <- paste0(
        txt,
        sprintf(
          " z_%d",
          j
        )
      )
    }
    writeLines(
      txt,
      con
    )
  }
  writeLines(
    "End",
    con
  )
  close(
    con
  )
  solve_start <- proc.time()[3]
  out <- suppressWarnings(
    system2(
      python_bin,
      args = c(
        shQuote(
          CPLEX_SOLVER_SCRIPT
        ),
        shQuote(
          lpfile
        ),
        shQuote(
          solfile
        ),
        as.character(
          time_limit
        )
      ),
      stdout = TRUE,
      stderr = TRUE
    )
  )
  solve_seconds <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    solve_start
  process_status <- attr(
    out,
    "status"
  )
  if (is.null(process_status)) {
    process_status <- 0L
  }
  get_output_value <- function(
      prefix
  ) {
    line <- grep(
      paste0(
        "^",
        prefix
      ),
      out,
      value = TRUE
    )
    if (length(line) == 0) {
      return(
        NA_character_
      )
    }
    sub(
      paste0(
        "^",
        prefix,
        "[[:space:]]*"
      ),
      "",
      line[1]
    )
  }
  cplex_status_code <- suppressWarnings(
    as.integer(
      get_output_value(
        "CPLEX status code:"
      )
    )
  )
  cplex_status <- get_output_value(
    "CPLEX status:"
  )
  mip_gap <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      get_output_value(
        "MIP gap:"
      )
    )
  )
  cplex_objective <- suppressWarnings(
    as.numeric(
      get_output_value(
        "Objective:"
      )
    )
  )
  exception_line <- grep(
    "^CPLEX exception:",
    out,
    value = TRUE
  )
  exception_message <-
    if (
      length(
        exception_line
      ) >
      0
    ) {
      sub(
        "^CPLEX exception:[[:space:]]*",
        "",
        exception_line[1]
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  proven_optimal <-
    !is.na(
      cplex_status_code
    ) &&
    cplex_status_code ==
    101L
  reference_eligible <-
    !is.na(
      cplex_status_code
    ) &&
    cplex_status_code %in%
    c(
      101L,
      102L
    )
  timed_out <-
    !is.na(
      cplex_status_code
    ) &&
    cplex_status_code %in%
    c(
      107L,
      108L
    )
  has_solution <- file.exists(
    solfile
  )
  if (
    !is.na(
      cplex_status_code
    ) &&
    cplex_status_code ==
    101L
  ) {
    outcome <- "optimal"
  } else if (
    !is.na(
      cplex_status_code
    ) &&
    cplex_status_code ==
    102L
  ) {
    outcome <- "optimal_tolerance"
  } else if (
    !is.na(
      cplex_status_code
    ) &&
    cplex_status_code ==
    107L
  ) {
    outcome <- "time_limit_feasible"
  } else if (
    !is.na(
      cplex_status_code
    ) &&
    cplex_status_code ==
    108L
  ) {
    outcome <- "time_limit_no_incumbent"
  } else if (
    !has_solution
  ) {
    outcome <- "solver_failure"
  } else {
    outcome <- "other_feasible"
  }
  if (!has_solution) {
    error_message <-
      if (
        !is.na(
          exception_message
        )
      ) {
        exception_message
      } else if (
        !is.na(
          cplex_status
        )
      ) {
        paste(
          "CPLEX did not produce a feasible solution.",
          cplex_status
        )
      } else {
        paste(
          "CPLEX did not produce a feasible solution.",
          paste(
            out,
            collapse = " "
          )
        )
      }
    return(
      list(
        selected =
          integer(
            0
          ),
        beta =
          numeric(
            p
          ),
        z =
          numeric(
            p
          ),
        rss =
          NA_real_,
        status =
          cplex_status,
        status_code =
          cplex_status_code,
        mip_gap =
          mip_gap,
        objective =
          cplex_objective,
        solve_seconds =
          solve_seconds,
        max_abs_beta =
          NA_real_,
        has_solution =
          FALSE,
        proven_optimal =
          proven_optimal,
        reference_eligible =
          reference_eligible,
        timed_out =
          timed_out,
        outcome =
          outcome,
        process_status =
          process_status,
        error =
          error_message,
        cplex_output =
          out
      )
    )
  }
  sol <- readLines(
    solfile,
    warn = FALSE
  )
  beta <- numeric(
    p
  )
  z <- numeric(
    p
  )
  for (line in sol) {
    if (
      !grepl(
        "<variable",
        line,
        fixed = TRUE
      )
    ) {
      next
    }
    name_match <- regmatches(
      line,
      regexec(
        'name="([^"]+)"',
        line,
        perl = TRUE
      )
    )[[1]]
    if (
      length(
        name_match
      ) !=
      2
    ) {
      next
    }
    name <- name_match[
      2
    ]
    value_match <- regmatches(
      line,
      regexec(
        'value="([-+]?(?:[0-9]+(?:\\.[0-9]*)?|\\.[0-9]+)(?:[eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?)"',
        line,
        perl = TRUE
      )
    )[[1]]
    if (
      length(
        value_match
      ) !=
      2
    ) {
      next
    }
    value <- as.numeric(
      value_match[
        2
      ]
    )
    if (
      grepl(
        "^beta_[0-9]+$",
        name
      )
    ) {
      j <- as.integer(
        sub(
          "^beta_",
          "",
          name
        )
      )
      if (
        !is.na(j) &&
        j <= p
      ) {
        beta[
          j
        ] <- value
      }
    }
    if (
      grepl(
        "^z_[0-9]+$",
        name
      )
    ) {
      j <- as.integer(
        sub(
          "^z_",
          "",
          name
        )
      )
      if (
        !is.na(j) &&
        j <= p
      ) {
        z[
          j
        ] <- value
      }
    }
  }
  selected <- which(
    z > 0.5
  )
  rss <- sum(
    (
      y -
      as.vector(
        X %*%
        beta
      )
    )^2
  )
  max_abs_beta <- max(
    abs(
      beta
    )
  )
  if (
    max_abs_beta >
    0.95 *
    M
  ) {
    warning(
      "A CPLEX coefficient is close to Big-M."
    )
  }
  list(
    selected =
      selected,
    beta =
      beta,
    z =
      z,
    rss =
      rss,
    status =
      cplex_status,
    status_code =
      cplex_status_code,
    mip_gap =
      mip_gap,
    objective =
      cplex_objective,
    solve_seconds =
      solve_seconds,
    max_abs_beta =
      max_abs_beta,
    has_solution =
      TRUE,
    proven_optimal =
      proven_optimal,
    reference_eligible =
      reference_eligible,
    timed_out =
      timed_out,
    outcome =
      outcome,
    process_status =
      process_status,
    error =
      NA_character_,
    cplex_output =
      out
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 6
# Paired dimensionality data-generating process
generate_replication_base <- function(
    rep_id,
    n,
    p_min,
    p_max,
    rho,
    s_true,
    beta_min,
    beta_max,
    target_snr,
    master_seed
) {
  set.seed(
    master_seed +
    rep_id
  )
  common_factor <- rnorm(
    n
  )
  Z <- matrix(
    rnorm(
      n *
      p_max
    ),
    nrow =
      n,
    ncol =
      p_max
  )
  X_raw <-
    sqrt(
      rho
    ) *
    matrix(
      common_factor,
      nrow = n,
      ncol = p_max
    ) +
    sqrt(
      1 -
      rho
    ) *
    Z
  Sigma_rho <-
    (
      1 -
      rho
    ) *
    diag(
      p_max
    ) +
    rho *
    matrix(
      1,
      nrow = p_max,
      ncol = p_max
    )
  true_support <- sort(
    sample(
      seq_len(
        p_min
      ),
      size =
        s_true,
      replace =
        FALSE
    )
  )
  magnitudes <- runif(
    s_true,
    min =
      beta_min,
    max =
      beta_max
  )
  signs <- sample(
    c(
      -1,
      1
    ),
    size =
      s_true,
    replace =
      TRUE
  )
  beta_values <-
    signs *
    magnitudes
  beta_true <- numeric(
    p_max
  )
  beta_true[
    true_support
  ] <- beta_values
  population_signal_variance <- as.numeric(
    t(
      beta_true
    ) %*%
    Sigma_rho %*%
    beta_true
  )
  sigma_sq <-
    population_signal_variance /
    target_snr
  sigma <- sqrt(
    sigma_sq
  )
  epsilon_base <- rnorm(
    n
  )
  epsilon <-
    sigma *
    epsilon_base
  signal_raw <- as.vector(
    X_raw %*%
    beta_true
  )
  y_raw <-
    signal_raw +
    epsilon
  X <- as.matrix(
    scale(
      X_raw,
      center = TRUE,
      scale = TRUE
    )
  )
  colnames(
    X
  ) <- paste0(
    "X",
    seq_len(
      p_max
    )
  )
  y <- as.numeric(
    y_raw -
    mean(
      y_raw
    )
  )
  realised_snr <-
    var(
      signal_raw
    ) /
    var(
      epsilon
    )
  list(
    X =
      X,
    X_raw =
      X_raw,
    y =
      y,
    y_raw =
      y_raw,
    beta_true =
      beta_true,
    true_support =
      true_support,
    beta_values =
      beta_values,
    Sigma_rho =
      Sigma_rho,
    signal_raw =
      signal_raw,
    epsilon =
      epsilon,
    epsilon_base =
      epsilon_base,
    population_signal_variance =
      population_signal_variance,
    target_snr =
      target_snr,
    sigma_sq =
      sigma_sq,
    sigma =
      sigma,
    realised_snr =
      realised_snr
  )
}
make_dataset_p <- function(
    base,
    p_value
) {
  X <- base$X[
    ,
    seq_len(
      p_value
    ),
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  beta_true <- base$beta_true[
    seq_len(
      p_value
    )
  ]
  list(
    X =
      X,
    y =
      base$y,
    beta_true =
      beta_true,
    true_support =
      base$true_support,
    target_snr =
      base$target_snr,
    population_signal_variance =
      base$population_signal_variance,
    sigma_sq =
      base$sigma_sq,
    sigma =
      base$sigma,
    realised_snr =
      base$realised_snr
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 7
# Common helper functions
ols_refit <- function(
    X,
    y,
    support
) {
  support <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(
        support
      )
    )
  )
  p <- ncol(
    X
  )
  if (
    length(
      support
    ) ==
    0
  ) {
    return(
      list(
        beta =
          numeric(
            p
          ),
        fitted =
          rep(
            0,
            length(
              y
            )
          ),
        rss =
          sum(
            y^2
          )
      )
    )
  }
  Xs <- X[
    ,
    support,
    drop = FALSE
  ]
  fit <- lm.fit(
    x = Xs,
    y = y
  )
  if (
    any(
      !is.finite(
        fit$coefficients
      )
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      "OLS refit produced non-finite coefficients."
    )
  }
  beta <- numeric(
    p
  )
  beta[
    support
  ] <- fit$coefficients
  fitted <- as.vector(
    X %*%
    beta
  )
  rss <- sum(
    (
      y -
      fitted
    )^2
  )
  list(
    beta =
      beta,
    fitted =
      fitted,
    rss =
      rss
  )
}
support_metrics <- function(
    selected,
    truth
) {
  selected <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(
        selected
      )
    )
  )
  truth <- sort(
    unique(
      as.integer(
        truth
      )
    )
  )
  TP <- length(
    intersect(
      selected,
      truth
    )
  )
  FP <- length(
    setdiff(
      selected,
      truth
    )
  )
  FN <- length(
    setdiff(
      truth,
      selected
    )
  )
  precision <-
    if (
      length(
        selected
      ) >
      0
    ) {
      TP /
      length(
        selected
      )
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  recall <-
    TP /
    length(
      truth
    )
  union_size <- length(
    union(
      selected,
      truth
    )
  )
  jaccard <-
    if (
      union_size >
      0
    ) {
      TP /
      union_size
    } else {
      1
    }
  list(
    exact =
      setequal(
        selected,
        truth
      ),
    TP =
      TP,
    FP =
      FP,
    FN =
      FN,
    precision =
      precision,
    recall =
      recall,
    jaccard =
      jaccard
  )
}
mean_safe <- function(
    x
) {
  if (
    length(
```

```{r}
# COMBSS wrapper
fit_combss_method <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s
) {
  start_time <- proc.time()[3]
  fit <- withCallingHandlers(
    combss::combss(
      x = X,
      y = y,
      family = "gaussian",
      q = s,
      lam_ridge = 0,
      Niter = 100,
      alpha = 0.1,
      scale = FALSE,
      verbose = FALSE
    ),
    warning = function(w) {
      msg <- conditionMessage(
        w
      )
      if (
        grepl(
          "Passing 'thresh' to glmnet",
          msg,
          fixed = TRUE
        ) ||
        grepl(
          "Passing 'maxit' to glmnet",
          msg,
          fixed = TRUE
        )
      ) {
        invokeRestart(
          "muffleWarning"
        )
      }
    }
  )
  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    start_time
  if (
    length(
      fit$subset_list
    ) <
    s
  ) {
    stop(
      paste(
        "COMBSS did not return model size",
        s
      )
    )
  }
  support <- sort(
    as.integer(
      fit$subset_list[[
        s
      ]]
    )
  )
  list(
    support =
      support,
    runtime =
      runtime,
    exact_size_available =
      length(
        support
      ) ==
      s
  )
}
```

```{r}
# ABESS wrapper
fit_abess_method <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s
) {
  start_time <- proc.time()[3]
  fit <- abess::abess(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    family = "gaussian",
    tune.path = "sequence",
    support.size = s,
    tune.type = "gic",
    lambda = 0,
    normalize = 0,
    fit.intercept = FALSE,
    early.stop = FALSE,
    warm.start = TRUE,
    num.threads = 1
  )
  model <- abess::extract(
    fit,
    support.size = s
  )
  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    start_time
  beta_hat <- as.numeric(
    model$beta
  )
  support <- sort(
    which(
      abs(
        beta_hat
      ) >
      1e-10
    )
  )
  list(
    support =
      support,
    runtime =
      runtime,
    exact_size_available =
      length(
        support
      ) ==
      s
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 11
# L0Learn dense path with gap refinement
fit_l0learn_dense <- function(
    X,
    y,
    target_s,
    max_support,
    grid_points = 1200,
    upper_multiplier = 2,
    lower_multiplier = 0.02,
    refine_points = 100,
    refine_rounds = 2
) {
  total_start <- proc.time()[3]
  pilot_fit <- L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(
    x = X,
    y = y,
    loss = "SquaredError",
    penalty = "L0",
    algorithm = "CD",
    maxSuppSize =
      max_support,
    nLambda =
      100,
    scaleDownFactor =
      0.80,
    intercept =
      FALSE
  )
  pilot_lambda <- as.numeric(
    pilot_fit$lambda[[
      1
    ]]
  )
  pilot_lambda <- pilot_lambda[
    is.finite(
      pilot_lambda
    ) &
    pilot_lambda >
    0
  ]
  if (
    length(
      pilot_lambda
    ) <
    2
  ) {
    stop(
      "L0Learn pilot path did not produce a usable lambda range."
    )
  }
  lambda_upper <-
    max(
      pilot_lambda
    ) *
    upper_multiplier
  lambda_lower <-
    min(
      pilot_lambda
    ) *
    lower_multiplier
  lambda_grid <- exp(
    seq(
      from =
        log(
          lambda_upper
        ),
      to =
        log(
          lambda_lower
        ),
      length.out =
        grid_points
    )
  )
  fit_grid <- function(
      lambda_values
  ) {
    L0Learn::L0Learn.fit(
      x = X,
      y = y,
      loss = "SquaredError",
      penalty = "L0",
      algorithm = "CDPSI",
      maxSuppSize =
        max_support,
      lambdaGrid =
        list(
          lambda_values
        ),
      partialSort =
        TRUE,
      maxIters =
        200,
      rtol =
        1e-6,
      atol =
        1e-9,
      activeSet =
        TRUE,
      activeSetNum =
        3,
      maxSwaps =
        100,
      screenSize =
        ncol(
          X
        ),
      intercept =
        FALSE
    )
  }
  fit <- fit_grid(
    lambda_grid
  )
  support_sizes <- as.integer(
    fit$suppSize[[
      1
    ]]
  )
  fitted_lambda <- as.numeric(
    fit$lambda[[
      1
    ]]
  )
  rounds_used <- 0L
  for (
    refinement_round in seq_len(
      refine_rounds
    )
  ) {
    if (
      length(
        support_sizes
      ) <
      2
    ) {
      break
    }
    gap_indices <- which(
      abs(
        diff(
          support_sizes
        )
      ) >
      1
    )
    if (
      length(
        gap_indices
      ) ==
      0
    ) {
      break
    }
    extra_lambda <- numeric(
      0
    )
    for (
      i in gap_indices
    ) {
      lambda_a <- fitted_lambda[
        i
      ]
      lambda_b <- fitted_lambda[
        i + 1
      ]
      upper <- max(
        lambda_a,
        lambda_b
      )
      lower <- min(
        lambda_a,
        lambda_b
      )
      if (
        is.finite(
          upper
        ) &&
        is.finite(
          lower
        ) &&
        lower >
        0 &&
        upper >
        lower
      ) {
        local_grid <- exp(
          seq(
            from =
              log(
                upper
              ),
            to =
              log(
                lower
              ),
            length.out =
              refine_points +
              2
          )
        )
        local_grid <- local_grid[
          -c(
            1,
            length(
              local_grid
            )
          )
        ]
        extra_lambda <- c(
          extra_lambda,
          local_grid
        )
      }
    }
    if (
      length(
        extra_lambda
      ) ==
      0
    ) {
      break
    }
    lambda_grid <- sort(
      unique(
        c(
          lambda_grid,
          extra_lambda
        )
      ),
      decreasing =
        TRUE
    )
    fit <- fit_grid(
      lambda_grid
    )
    support_sizes <- as.integer(
      fit$suppSize[[
        1
      ]]
    )
    fitted_lambda <- as.numeric(
      fit$lambda[[
        1
      ]]
    )
    rounds_used <-
      refinement_round
  }
  beta_path <- as.matrix(
    fit$beta[[
      1
    ]]
  )
  if (
    ncol(
      beta_path
    ) !=
    length(
      support_sizes
    )
  ) {
    stop(
      "L0Learn beta path and support-size path have inconsistent lengths."
    )
  }
  available_sizes <- sort(
    unique(
      support_sizes
    )
  )
  available_sizes <- available_sizes[
    available_sizes <=
    max_support
  ]
  exact_indices <- which(
    support_sizes ==
    target_s
  )
  exact_size_available <-
    length(
      exact_indices
    ) >
    0
  support <- integer(
    0
  )
  selected_lambda <- NA_real_
  if (
    exact_size_available
  ) {
    candidate_rss <- rep(
      NA_real_,
      length(
        exact_indices
      )
    )
    candidate_supports <- vector(
      mode = "list",
      length = length(
        exact_indices
      )
    )
    for (
      ii in seq_along(
        exact_indices
      )
    ) {
      j <- exact_indices[
        ii
      ]
      beta_j <- beta_path[
        ,
        j
      ]
      support_j <- sort(
        which(
          abs(
            beta_j
          ) >
          1e-10
        )
      )
      candidate_supports[[
        ii
      ]] <- support_j
      candidate_rss[
        ii
      ] <- ols_refit(
        X = X,
        y = y,
        support =
          support_j
      )$rss
    }
    best_candidate <- which.min(
      candidate_rss
    )
    best_index <- exact_indices[
      best_candidate
    ]
    support <- candidate_supports[[
      best_candidate
    ]]
    selected_lambda <- fitted_lambda[
      best_index
    ]
  }
  nearest_size <-
    if (
      length(
        available_sizes
      ) >
      0
    ) {
      available_sizes[
        which.min(
          abs(
            available_sizes -
            target_s
          )
        )
      ]
    } else {
      NA_integer_
    }
  runtime <-
    proc.time()[3] -
    total_start
  list(
    support =
      support,
    runtime =
      runtime,
    exact_size_available =
      exact_size_available,
    selected_lambda =
      selected_lambda,
    available_sizes =
      available_sizes,
    number_distinct_sizes =
      length(
        available_sizes
      ),
    nearest_size =
      nearest_size,
    refined =
      rounds_used >
      0,
    refinement_rounds_used =
      rounds_used,
    number_lambda_values =
      length(
        fitted_lambda
      ),
    raw_support_sizes =
      support_sizes,
    fit =
      fit
  )
}
fit_l0learn_method <- function(
    X,
    y,
    s
) {
  fit_l0learn_dense(
    X = X,
    y = y,
    target_s =
      s,
    max_support =
      l0_max_support,
    grid_points =
      l0_grid_points,
    upper_multiplier =
      l0_upper_multiplier,
    lower_multiplier =
      l0_lower_multiplier,
    refine_points =
      l0_refine_points,
    refine_rounds =
      l0_refine_rounds
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 12
# Safe fitting and result-row helpers
safe_fit <- function(
    fit_function,
    ...
) {
  start_time <- proc.time()[3]
  tryCatch(
    {
      ans <- fit_function(
        ...
      )
      if (
        is.null(
          ans$runtime
        )
      ) {
        ans$runtime <-
          proc.time()[3] -
          start_time
      }
      if (
        is.null(
          ans$success
        )
      ) {
        ans$success <- TRUE
      }
      if (
        is.null(
          ans$error
        )
      ) {
        ans$error <- NA_character_
      }
      ans
    },
    error = function(e) {
      list(
        success =
          FALSE,
        support =
          integer(
            0
          ),
        runtime =
          proc.time()[3] -
          start_time,
        exact_size_available =
          FALSE,
        error =
          conditionMessage(
            e
          )
      )
    }
  )
}
make_result_row <- function(
    rep_id,
    p_value,
    method,
    fit,
    data
) {
  fit_success <- isTRUE(
    fit$success
  )
  exact_size_available <- isTRUE(
    fit$exact_size_available
  )
  valid_support <-
    fit_success &&
    exact_size_available
  if (
    valid_support
  ) {
    selected <- sort(
      as.integer(
        fit$support
      )
    )
    metrics <- support_metrics(
      selected =
        selected,
      truth =
        data$true_support
    )
    refit <- ols_refit(
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      support =
        selected
    )
    selected_size <- length(
      selected
    )
    exact_recovery <- metrics$exact
    TP <- metrics$TP
    FP <- metrics$FP
    FN <- metrics$FN
    precision <- metrics$precision
    recall <- metrics$recall
    jaccard <- metrics$jaccard
    rss <- refit$rss
    support_key <- paste(
      selected,
      collapse = ","
    )
  } else {
    selected_size <- NA_integer_
    exact_recovery <- NA
    TP <- NA_integer_
    FP <- NA_integer_
    FN <- NA_integer_
    precision <- NA_real_
    recall <- NA_real_
    jaccard <- NA_real_
    rss <- NA_real_
    support_key <- NA_character_
  }
  cplex_status <- value_or(
    fit$status,
    NA_character_
  )
  cplex_status_code <- value_or(
    fit$status_code,
    NA_integer_
  )
  cplex_gap <- value_or(
    fit$mip_gap,
    NA_real_
  )
  cplex_proven_optimal <- value_or(
    fit$proven_optimal,
    NA
  )
  cplex_reference_eligible <- value_or(
    fit$reference_eligible,
    NA
  )
  cplex_timed_out <- value_or(
    fit$timed_out,
    NA
  )
  cplex_has_incumbent <- value_or(
    fit$has_incumbent,
    NA
  )
  cplex_outcome <- value_or(
    fit$outcome,
    NA_character_
  )
  big_m_ratio <-
    if (
      !is.null(
        fit$max_abs_beta
      ) &&
      is.finite(
        fit$max_abs_beta
      )
    ) {
      fit$max_abs_beta /
      big_M
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
  l0_distinct_sizes <- value_or(
    fit$number_distinct_sizes,
    NA_integer_
  )
  l0_available_sizes <-
    if (
      !is.null(
        fit$available_sizes
      )
    ) {
      paste(
        fit$available_sizes,
        collapse = ","
      )
    } else {
      NA_character_
    }
  l0_nearest_size <- value_or(
    fit$nearest_size,
    NA_integer_
  )
  l0_refined <- value_or(
    fit$refined,
    NA
  )
  l0_refinement_rounds <- value_or(
    fit$refinement_rounds_used,
    NA_integer_
  )
  l0_lambda_points <- value_or(
    fit$number_lambda_values,
    NA_integer_
  )
  data.frame(
    rep =
      rep_id,
    n =
      nrow(
        data$X
      ),
    p =
      p_value,
    p_over_n =
      p_value /
      nrow(
        data$X
      ),
    s_true =
      length(
        data$true_support
      ),
    method =
      method,
    success =
      fit_success,
    exact_size_available =
      exact_size_available,
    selected_size =
      selected_size,
    exact_recovery =
      exact_recovery,
    TP =
      TP,
    FP =
      FP,
    FN =
      FN,
    precision =
      precision,
    recall =
      recall,
    jaccard =
      jaccard,
    rss =
      rss,
    runtime =
      value_or(
        fit$runtime,
        NA_real_
      ),
    target_snr =
      data$target_snr,
    population_signal_variance =
      data$population_signal_variance,
    sigma_sq =
      data$sigma_sq,
    sigma =
      data$sigma,
    realised_snr =
      data$realised_snr,
    support_key =
      support_key,
    true_support_key =
      paste(
        data$true_support,
        collapse = ","
      ),
    cplex_status =
      cplex_status,
    cplex_status_code =
      cplex_status_code,
    cplex_gap =
      cplex_gap,
    cplex_proven_optimal =
      cplex_proven_optimal,
    cplex_reference_eligible =
      cplex_reference_eligible,
    cplex_timed_out =
      cplex_timed_out,
    cplex_has_incumbent =
      cplex_has_incumbent,
    cplex_outcome =
      cplex_outcome,
    big_m_ratio =
      big_m_ratio,
    l0_distinct_sizes =
      l0_distinct_sizes,
    l0_available_sizes =
      l0_available_sizes,
    l0_nearest_size =
      l0_nearest_size,
    l0_refined =
      l0_refined,
    l0_refinement_rounds =
      l0_refinement_rounds,
    l0_lambda_points =
      l0_lambda_points,
    error =
      value_or(
        fit$error,
        NA_character_
      ),
    stringsAsFactors =
      FALSE
  )
}
```

```{r}
# Section 14
# Main Experiment 3: fresh run only
results <- NULL
experiment_start <- Sys.time()
for (
  r in seq_len(
    n_rep
  )
) {
  cat(
    "\n============================================================\n"
  )
  cat(
    "REPLICATION",
    r,
    "OF",
    n_rep,
    "\n"
  )
  cat(
    "============================================================\n"
  )
  base <- generate_replication_base(
    rep_id =
      r,
    n =
      n,
    p_min =
      p_min,
    p_max =
      p_max,
    rho =
      rho,
    s_true =
      s_true,
    beta_min =
      beta_min,
    beta_max =
      beta_max,
    target_snr =
      target_snr,
    master_seed =
      master_seed
  )
  for (
    p_value in p_values
  ) {
    cat(
      "\n------------------------------------------------------------\n"
    )
    cat(
      "p =",
      p_value,
      "| p/n =",
      round(
        p_value / n,
        2
      ),
      "\n"
    )
    data <- make_dataset_p(
      base =
        base,
      p_value =
        p_value
    )
    cat(
      "  CPLEX..."
    )
    fit <- safe_fit(
      fit_cplex_method,
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      s =
        s_true,
      M =
        big_M,
      time_limit =
        cplex_time_limit
    )
    results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      results,
      make_result_row(
        rep_id =
          r,
        p_value =
          p_value,
        method =
          "CPLEX",
        fit =
          fit,
        data =
          data
      )
    )
    cat(
      " done in",
      round(
        fit$runtime,
        2
      ),
      "seconds"
    )
    if (
      !is.null(
        fit$outcome
      )
    ) {
      cat(
        " |",
        fit$outcome
      )
    }
    cat(
      "\n"
    )
    cat(
      "  COMBSS..."
    )
    fit <- safe_fit(
      fit_combss_method,
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      s =
        s_true
    )
    results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      results,
      make_result_row(
        rep_id =
          r,
        p_value =
          p_value,
        method =
          "COMBSS",
        fit =
          fit,
        data =
          data
      )
    )
    cat(
      " done in",
      round(
        fit$runtime,
        2
      ),
      "seconds\n"
    )
    cat(
      "  ABESS..."
    )
    fit <- safe_fit(
      fit_abess_method,
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      s =
        s_true
    )
    results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      results,
      make_result_row(
        rep_id =
          r,
        p_value =
          p_value,
        method =
          "ABESS",
        fit =
          fit,
        data =
          data
      )
    )
    cat(
      " done in",
      round(
        fit$runtime,
        2
      ),
      "seconds\n"
    )
    cat(
      "  L0Learn..."
    )
    fit <- safe_fit(
      fit_l0learn_method,
      X =
        data$X,
      y =
        data$y,
      s =
        s_true
    )
    results <- dplyr::bind_rows(
      results,
      make_result_row(
        rep_id =
          r,
        p_value =
          p_value,
        method =
          "L0Learn",
        fit =
          fit,
        data =
          data
      )
    )
    cat(
      " done in",
      round(
        fit$runtime,
        2
      ),
      "seconds\n"
    )
  }
  elapsed <- difftime(
    Sys.time(),
    experiment_start,
    units = "hours"
  )
  cat(
    "\nReplication",
    r,
    "complete. Elapsed:",
    round(
      as.numeric(
        elapsed
      ),
      2
    ),
    "hours.\n"
  )
}
experiment_end <- Sys.time()
results <- results %>%
  dplyr::arrange(
    rep,
    p,
    method
  )
cat(
  "\nExperiment completed.\n"
)
cat(
  "Total elapsed time:",
  as.character(
    experiment_end -
    experiment_start
  ),
  "\n"
)
```

```{r}
# Section 19
# Compare approximate methods with valid CPLEX benchmarks
cplex_reference <- raw_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    method ==
    "CPLEX",
    success,
    exact_size_available,
    cplex_reference_eligible %in%
    TRUE
  ) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    rep,
    p,
    cplex_support_key =
      support_key,
    cplex_rss =
      rss,
    cplex_reference_status =
      cplex_status,
    cplex_reference_gap =
      cplex_gap
  )
cplex_duplicate_check <- cplex_reference %>%
  dplyr::count(
    rep,
    p,
    name = "n_rows"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n_rows !=
    1
  )
if (
  nrow(
    cplex_duplicate_check
  ) >
  0
) {
  print(
    cplex_duplicate_check
  )
  stop(
    "The valid CPLEX reference is not unique for some (rep, p) combinations."
  )
}
results_with_cplex <- raw_results %>%
  dplyr::left_join(
    cplex_reference,
    by = c(
      "rep",
      "p"
    ),
    relationship =
      "many-to-one"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    agrees_with_cplex =
      ifelse(
        success &
        exact_size_available &
        !is.na(
          cplex_support_key
        ),
        support_key ==
        cplex_support_key,
        NA
      ),
    relative_rss_gap =
      ifelse(
        success &
        exact_size_available &
        !is.na(
          cplex_rss
        ) &
        cplex_rss >
        0,
        (
          rss -
          cplex_rss
        ) /
        cplex_rss,
        NA_real_
      )
  )
saveRDS(
  results_with_cplex,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "experiment3_results_with_cplex.rds"
  )
)
write.csv(
  results_with_cplex,
  file.path(
    output_dir,
    "experiment3_results_with_cplex.csv"
  ),
  row.names =
    FALSE
)
```

```{r}
# Section 21
# Exact support recovery versus dimensionality
recovery_plot_data <- results_with_cplex %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    success,
    exact_size_available
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    p,
    method
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    recovery_rate =
      mean(
        exact_recovery,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    n_available =
      dplyr::n(),
    .groups =
      "drop"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    se =
      sqrt(
        recovery_rate *
        (
          1 -
          recovery_rate
        ) /
        n_available
      ),
    lower =
      pmax(
        0,
        recovery_rate -
        1.96 *
        se
      ),
    upper =
      pmin(
        1,
        recovery_rate +
        1.96 *
        se
      )
  )
p_recovery <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  recovery_plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x =
      p,
    y =
      recovery_rate,
    group =
      method,
    linetype =
      method,
    shape =
      method
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = n,
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
    ggplot2::aes(
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper
    ),
    width = 4
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = p_values
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(
      0,
      1
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x =
      "Number of predictors p",
    y =
      "Exact support recovery rate",
    linetype =
      "Method",
    shape =
      "Method"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
print(
  p_recovery
)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename =
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      "exact_support_recovery_vs_dimensionality.png"
    ),
  plot =
    p_recovery,
  width =
    10,
  height =
    6,
  dpi =
    300
)
```

```{r}
# Section 28
# Number of distinct L0Learn support sizes
l0_distinct_plot_data <- raw_results %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    method ==
    "L0Learn"
  ) %>%
  dplyr::group_by(
    p
  ) %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_distinct_sizes =
      mean_safe(
        l0_distinct_sizes
      ),
    median_distinct_sizes =
      median_safe(
        l0_distinct_sizes
      ),
    .groups =
      "drop"
  )
p_l0_distinct <- ggplot2::ggplot(
  l0_distinct_plot_data,
  ggplot2::aes(
    x =
      p,
    y =
      mean_distinct_sizes
  )
) +
  ggplot2::geom_vline(
    xintercept = n,
    linetype = "dotted"
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_line() +
  ggplot2::geom_point(
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = p_values
  ) +
  ggplot2::labs(
    x =
      "Number of predictors p",
    y =
      "Mean number of distinct L0Learn model sizes"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal()
print(
  p_l0_distinct
)
ggplot2::ggsave(
  filename =
    file.path(
      output_dir,
      "l0learn_distinct_sizes_vs_dimensionality.png"
    ),

    p_l0_distinct,
  width =
    10,
  height =
    6,
  dpi =
    300
)
```

```{r}
# Section 29
# Final experiment integrity checks
expected_rows <-
  n_rep *
  length(
    p_values
  ) *
  4
cat(
  "Expected result rows:",
  expected_rows,
  "\n"
)
cat(
  "Observed result rows:",
  nrow(
    raw_results
  ),
  "\n"
)
if (
  nrow(
    raw_results
  ) !=
  expected_rows
) {
  warning(
    "The experiment does not contain every expected method fit."
  )
}
duplicate_check <- raw_results %>%
  dplyr::count(
    rep,
    p,
    method
  ) %>%
  dplyr::filter(
    n >
    1
  )
if (
  nrow(
    duplicate_check
  ) >
  0
) {
  print(
    duplicate_check
  )
  stop(
    "Duplicate (rep, p, method) rows were detected."
  )
}
snr_check <- raw_results %>%
  dplyr::summarise(
    minimum_target_snr =
      min(
        target_snr,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    maximum_target_snr =
      max(
        target_snr,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    minimum_realised_snr =
      min(
        realised_snr,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ),
    maximum_realised_snr =
      max(
        realised_snr,
        na.rm = TRUE
      )
  )
print(
  snr_check
)
cat(
  "Experiment 3 integrity checks complete.\n"
)
```
